name: sc-accelerator-factory
description: Factory skills for the Service Cloud Accelerator: turn a support organisation's requirements into a tailored, generic Service Cloud implementation — Case support processes, Entitlements and milestones, Omni-Channel routing, Lightning Knowledge and a self-service Help Center — without forking the product and without Public Sector Solutions. Assesses an existing org for routing and SLA collisions and retired surfaces, scopes the configuration footprint, detects the add-on licences a scope triggers, gates the build on a support process whose closed statuses close, and adds deltas incrementally. Not public-sector case management.
